sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/110 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 110, search/grid facilities 418 'Sites 001 - 100' and 419 'Sites 101 - 214' for 2027-06-15, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-04-13, 2027-04-27, search/details for all web-listed units on 2027-06-15, plus site 001 on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12 and 2027-06-19, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Every RV site is electric: $39 a night, the same on a Saturday (June 2027); off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) $35. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Delaware units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 39.00, Fee 6.50); site 001 on Sat 2027-06-19 (39.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (35.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (all 203 campsites 'Campsite Electric', Electricity Hookup '50', no water or sewer hookup listed on any) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/delaware-state-park-campground ('214 Electric sites'; 'Potable water fill and dump station'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 203 web-bookable electric sites (ODNR: 214, four with ADA features) in four wooded areas, all back-in, rated for camping units 42-88 ft (most 45-57). Area C (sites 101-157) closed from October 4, 2026 for a construction project; ReserveOhio still blocks it through April 2027. Two domestic pets per site.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (418: 96 units, 419: 109 units incl. group camps; 2027-04-27: sites #101-#157 among 68 blocked) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length 42-88) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/delaware-state-park-campground ('NOTICE (9/22/26): Area C of the campground (sites 101-157) will be closed beginning October 4, 2026, for a construction project.'; '214 Electric sites including four with ADA features'; 'Two domestic pets per site'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Seasonal camp store; fenced dog park near the campground entrance; disc golf and mini golf in the campground; tornado shelter. Amenities change in winter.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/delaware-state-park-campground ('Flush toilets, showers, laundry facilities'; 'Potable water fill and dump station'; 'Camp Store sells firewood, ice, and camping supplies; open seasonally.'; 'Fenced dog park near campground entrance'; 'Tornado Shelter') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/delaware-state-park ('NOTE: Campground amenities change during winter season.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: In winter only part of sites 1-100 is sold (about 20 open in November 2026 and January 2027); sites 101-214 are blocked November-March.

season.source: ReserveOhio search/grid for 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (facility 418: 16-19 units free, the rest blocked or taken; facility 419: all 109 blocked through 2027-03-16) + search/details rates for those dates, read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations required, up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. Every listed site is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/delaware-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

note: Heavily wooded campground in four areas linked to the lakeshore by hiking trails. Area C (sites 101-157) closed from October 4, 2026 for a construction project (ODNR notice 9/22/26); ReserveOhio blocks it through April 2027. --Claude
summary: Fees confirmed ($39, every site electric) and added the $35 off-peak rate. Added 50-amp electric, no water/sewer at sites, 203 back-in sites rated to 88 ft, showers/flush toilets/water fill/dump/laundry/camp store, year-round (part of 1-100 in winter), ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, reservations required, 14-night max; noted the Area C construction closure. Pin 649 m from the sites' centroid. Not stated: the weekend minimum (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (740) 363-4561 (the camp office).
Pin 649 m off: 199 m from the nearest site, at the south end of the campground's 2.4 km north-south spread. Centroid of ReserveOhio's 203 campsite coordinates: 40.40125,-83.05873.

Partial closure (a note, not a status): 'NOTICE (9/22/26): Area C of the campground (sites 101-157) will be closed beginning October 4, 2026, for a construction project.' ReserveOhio blocks sites 101-157 through 2027-04-27, the end of its window; no reopening date posted.
